versions.subject: rule: suspicious network connections no cmdline
versions.detection:
selection:
  Initiated: 'true'
  Image|endswith: 
    - '\regsvr32.exe'
    - '\rundll32.exe'
    - '\dllhost.exe'
  CommandLine|endswith:
    - '\regsvr32.exe'
    - '\rundll32.exe'
    - '\dllhost.exe'
filter_no_cmdline:
  CommandLine: ''
filter_null:  # e.g. Sysmon has no CommandLine field in network events with ID 3
  CommandLine: null
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: Initiated="true" Image IN ("*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\dllhost.exe") CommandLine IN ("*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\dllhost.exe") NOT (CommandLine="" OR NOT CommandLine=*)
